commentaire: Planches 3×3 en 4:3 (cellules PAYSAGE, ratio de la fenêtre d'illustration des fonds de carte, 2026-09-04) pour generate-cartes.mjs. Ordre = ordre des pochettes (src/data/cartes.ts). Rareté/série sont informatives ici : le cadre est un fond peint composé à l'écran par CarteDuel. Sujets = les objets source TOONIFIÉS, décrits sans marque ni personnage protégé. Depuis le 2026-09-04 soir : style « monstre né de l'objet » + décor contextuel (voir `style`), noms détournés dans src/data/cartes.ts.
style: Each panel is a collectible-card creature illustration in the manner of a dark, dramatic monster trading card: the object has BECOME a small MONSTER with real menace and personality — sly, grumpy, hungry or mischievous, never cute. CRUCIAL: its eyes and mouth are EXISTING PARTS of the object reinterpreted, never a face pasted on a blank surface: a dial, a lens, a knob, a keyhole, a speaker or a button becomes an eye (one single eye, two, or several, whichever the object suggests); a drawer, a keyboard, a grille, a hinge, a lid, a bellows, a slot or a row of teeth-like parts becomes the mouth; handles, legs, straps, spouts or cables become limbs, claws or tails. The creature fills most of its panel, large and in the foreground, with rich detail: cracked wood, worn metal, glowing eyes, drool, sharp fangs where the object allows. Painterly illustration with clean dark outlines, cel shading, dramatic warm lighting and a vintage palette. Behind each creature, a CONTEXTUAL BACKGROUND SCENE that fits the object (an attic, a workshop, a stage, a parlour, a street at night...), painted softer and less contrasted than the creature so the creature stays the focus.

styleV1_kawaii: Each panel is a bold flat cartoon MASCOT: the object PERSONIFIED as an adorable tiny monster — two big friendly round eyes, a small happy smile, and when it fits, tiny stubby arms and feet — playful kawaii style, thick dark-brown outlines, cel shading, warm vintage palette, the character centered and large on a plain soft cream background.
